hits.title: Bounded step functions and factorial ratio sequences
hits.snippet: We study certain step functions whose nonnegativity is related to the integrality of sequences of ratios of factorial products. In particular, we obtain a lower bound for the mean square of such step functions which allows us to give a restriction on when such a factorial ratio sequence can be integral. hits.title: A cohomological description of property (T) for quantum groups
hits.snippet: We prove a Delorme-Guichardet type theorem for discrete quantum groups expressing property (T) of the quantum group in question in terms of its first cohomology groups. As an application, we show that the first L^2-Betti number of a discrete property (T) quantum group vanishes.

hits.title: D-Bar Operators on Quantum Domains
hits.snippet: We study the index problem for the d-bar operators subject to Atiyah- Patodi-Singer boundary conditions on noncommutative disk and annulus.
